definitions.explanation: The traditional Japanese custom of admiring the autumn moon, especially the full moon in mid-September ({十五夜|じゅうごや}). Involves displaying pampas grass and eating rice dumplings.
A style of serving food with a raw egg on top, where the yolk resembles the full moon. Common with soba, udon, and hamburgers.

examples.japanese: {秋|あき}は{月見|つきみ}の{季節|きせつ}だ。
examples.english: Autumn is the season for moon viewing.

examples.japanese: {縁側|えんがわ}で{月見|つきみ}をしながら{団子|だんご}を{食|た}べた。
examples.english: I ate dumplings while viewing the moon from the veranda.

examples.japanese: {十五夜|じゅうごや}に{家族|かぞく}で{月見|つきみ}をするのが{毎年|まいとし}の{楽|たの}しみだ。
examples.english: Viewing the moon with my family on the night of the harvest moon is something I look forward to every year.

examples.japanese: {月見|つきみ}そばを{注文|ちゅうもん}した。
examples.english: I ordered a moon-viewing soba (soba with a raw egg).

examples.japanese: {月見|つきみ}うどんは{卵|たまご}が{入|はい}っている。
examples.english: Moon-viewing udon has an egg in it.

examples.japanese: ファストフード{店|てん}が{秋|あき}{限定|げんてい}の{月見|つきみ}バーガーを{発売|はつばい}して{話題|わだい}になった。
examples.english: A fast-food chain made headlines by releasing a limited autumn moon-viewing burger.

notes:
CULTURAL NOTE:
Moon viewing ({月見|つきみ}/お{月見|つきみ}) is one of Japan's traditional autumn customs, centered on {十五夜|じゅうごや} (the 15th night of the 8th lunar month, usually mid-September). People display {薄|すすき} (pampas grass) and offer {月見|つきみ}{団子|だんご} (rice dumplings) to appreciate the harvest moon.

Sense 2 comes from the resemblance of a raw egg yolk to the full moon. {月見|つきみ}そば and {月見|つきみ}うどん are standard menu items at noodle shops. McDonald's Japan's seasonal {月見|つきみ}バーガー has become a cultural event.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- お{月見|つきみ}: moon viewing (polite)
- {月見|つきみ}{団子|だんご}: moon-viewing dumplings
- {月見|つきみ}そば: soba with a raw egg
- {月見|つきみ}バーガー: moon-viewing burger (seasonal)
